The '''Warden Art''' is a {{Special}} Item that was obtainable during [[A Honk and Seek Adventure]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Warden Art''' had a {{Green|2%}} ({{Green|1}} in {{Yellow|50}}) chance to drop from killing any tier of {{MobSprite|Revenant Horror}}.

== Usage ==
Looking at a '''Warden Art''' while consuming a {{Item|Fudge Mint Core}} after using the {{Item|Jerry Helmet}} until the following message appeared, gave the player {{Item|An Extremely Difficult Item For You To Find}}: {{Dialogue|&a&lTHINK! &fThink &eJerry&f, THINK!}}
